name: 幻奏琴弓 Bow of Melodies (BMT)

description.value:
武器（任意弓），极珍稀（需同调）
这把弓有着多条弦（弓弦/琴弦），它形如一把里拉琴或一把小号竖琴。你可以在箭矢搭弦时弹奏弦，来为箭矢注入魔法的能量。当你用这把弓发动远程武器攻击时，你可以演奏以下旋律之一。你必须在攻击检定前选择你要演奏的旋律，且你在每次攻击中只能演奏一种旋律。

  • 精准旋律Melody of Precision。如果你熟练于表演&Reference[skill=Performance]技能，你的攻击检定将具有+1加值。如果你专精于表演&Reference[skill=Performance]技能，则改为获得+2加值。（原文如此）

  • 回响旋律Melody of Reverberation。你弹奏出的旋律响彻云霄。命中时，目标将受到等同于你魅力调整值点的额外雷鸣伤害。

This bow has multiple strings and resembles a lyre or small harp. By strumming the strings while setting an arrow to the bow, you imbue the arrow with magic.

You can play one of the following melodies when you use the bow to make a ranged weapon attack. You must choose to do so before you make the attack roll, and you can play only one melody per attack.

Melody of Precision. If you're proficient in &Reference[skill=Performance], you gain a +1 bonus to the attack roll. If you have expertise in &Reference[skill=Performance], you gain a +2 bonus instead.

Melody of Reverberation. The melody you strum echoes loudly. On a hit, the target takes extra thunder damage equal to your Charisma modifier.

Base items. This item variant can be applied to the following base items:

  • @item[Longbow|PHB] (@item[Longbow of Melodies|BMT])
  • @item[Shortbow|PHB] (@item[Shortbow of Melodies|BMT])
